title: Billing, Payment and Credit Control Figures for Private Event & Banquet Services
content:
Billing an event and collecting for it run on seven figures printed against the Private Event & Banquet Services package the agreement is written against.

| Package | Final invoice raised by, calendar days after the event | Payment due, calendar days from the final invoice | Monthly late charge, per cent | Grace before a late charge, calendar days | Late charge ceiling on one invoice, USD | Days past due at which booking stops | Goodwill adjustment ceiling, per cent of event value | Dispute window, calendar days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 3 | 15 | 1.5 | 3 | 150 | 30 | 15 | 7 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 5 | 15 | 1.5 | 3 | 400 | 45 | 20 | 10 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 7 | 21 | 1.25 | 5 | 1100 | 60 | 25 | 14 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 10 | 30 | 1.25 | 7 | 2800 | 75 | 30 | 21 |
| Gala Reception Package | 14 | 30 | 1.0 | 10 | 6500 | 90 | 35 | 30 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 21 | 45 | 1.0 | 10 | 12000 | 90 | 30 | 21 |

The first column is the calendar days after the event by which the final invoice is raised and the second the calendar days from the final invoice within which payment is due. The late charge columns are the monthly late charge on an overdue event invoice, as a percentage of the overdue amount, the calendar days past the due date before a late charge may be raised, and the ceiling on the late charge raised against one event invoice. The credit column is the days past due at which booking stops on the agreement. The goodwill column is the ceiling on any goodwill adjustment applied to a final bill, as a percentage of event value, and the last column is the calendar days after the final invoice within which the client may dispute it.

## Notes on the schedule

The monthly late percentage falls as the package rises — 1.5 on the two smallest packages, 1.25 in the middle and 1.0 at the top — while the ceiling on the charge rises from 150 to 12000, so the larger packages carry a slower charge against a far larger stop.

Payment terms stand at 15 days on both the Meeting Room Refreshment Package and the Boardroom Reception Package and at 30 days on both the Seated Banquet Package and the Gala Reception Package; only the Multi-Day Conference Residency Package reaches 45.

The Multi-Day Conference Residency Package is not the top of every column: its goodwill ceiling of 30 per cent and its dispute window of 21 days both sit below the 35 per cent and 30 days printed against the Gala Reception Package.
